pageTitle: Tennessee Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: How do I claim my Tennessee Lottery prize?
items.answer:
Tennessee Lottery winners can claim prizes of less than $600 directly from any authorized retailer. However, for winnings between $600 and $199,999, you’ll need to go to your local claim center. You’ll find a list of locations at the top of this page.

Alternatively, you can mail your original signed Tennessee Lottery ticket, but keep in mind that it takes a few weeks for processing. Lastly, you’ll need to claim prizes of $200,000 or more at the TN Lottery Headquarters in Nashville.

*Please check our COVID update on top of the page

items.question: How much time do I have to claim my prize?
items.answer: You can claim your prize within 180 days from the date of the official Tennessee Lottery results. For instant tickets, you’ll have 90 days to redeem your winnings from the time that the game ends.

items.question: Why must my Tennessee Lottery ticket be signed?
items.answer: If your ticket contains Tennessee Lottery winning numbers, then it’s crucial to validate it as your property by signing it. This ensures that no one can lay claim your winnings.

items.question: Where can I purchase Tennessee Lottery tickets?
items.answer: According to law, Tennessee Lottery Tickets can only be purchased from a participating retailer. Online, phone, and mail options aren’t permitted.

items.question: Are Tennessee Lottery prizes taxable?
items.answer: All Tennessee Lottery winners are responsible for paying federal taxes. Winnings higher than $600 are reported to the Internal Revenue Service, and you’ll have to present your Social Security Number to claim a prize. However, state taxes don’t apply.

items.question: How old must I be to legally participate in the Tennessee Lottery?
items.answer: You must be 18 years old and above to legally participate in the Tennessee State Lottery.

items.question: What games does the Tennessee Lottery offer & when are the draws?
items.answer:
Apart from Tennessee Lottery scratch tickets, there are also numerous daily draws. The various games and schedules are as follows:

Cash 3 & 4 morning – Monday to Saturday at 9:28 AM

Cash 3 & 4 midday – Monday to Saturday at 12:28 PM

Cash 3 & 4 evening – Monday to Sunday at 6:28 PM

Tennessee Lottery PowerBall – Wednesdays and Saturdays at 9:59 PM

Tennessee Lottery Mega Millions – Tuesdays and Fridays at 10:00 PM

Cash4Life – Daily at 8:00 PM (the Tennessee Lottery’s Lucky ForLife)

Tennessee Cash – Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10:30 PM

Lotto America – Wednesday and Saturday at 10:30 PM

items.question: Can I purchase advance draw tickets for the Tennessee Lottery?
items.answer: Yes. You may buy Tennessee Lottery tickets for a specified number of draws in advance.

items.question: Can I remain anonymous if I win the Tennessee Lottery jackpot?
items.answer: No. By law, the TN Lottery is allowed to release details of Tennessee Lottery winners. However, you may remain anonymous if you use a trust to claim the prize.

items.question: What are the Tennessee Lottery codes?
items.answer: All scratch tickets have a series of numbers printed on them. These codes are mostly used to verify winning numbers if a retailer’s Tennessee Lottery ticket scanner is out of order.

items.question: Is there a Tennessee Lottery second chance game?
items.answer: Yes. Apart from VIP rewards, there are also Tennessee Lottery second chance drawings, which allow you to re-enter non-winning tickets. You can use the website or play these games via the Tennessee Lottery app
